note: Canonical list of the regular Last War activities Muse is expected to perform. The every-4-hours run and every manual round work from this list. Cadence: every-run = redo each run (they regenerate); daily = once per server day; daily-reset = once per day and again after the 19:00 local reset; weekly-thu = Thursdays only.

regulars.name: Mail - check every category and Claim All
Alliance help - Help All, plus the main-screen help bubble whenever it pops
Alliance gifts - Claim All on Regular and Premium tabs
Harvest all resource bubbles (center taps; one farmland tap collects all food)
VIP Daily Freebie - claim; claim again in any round after the 19:00 reset
Passes - weekly/monthly daily pickups and Free Supply in the shop
Secret missions - claim finished (one Claim takes all), Mega Deploy the rest (UR Only off; on duel UR days Mega Refresh first), check Reward Recovery
Hidden treasures - dig when a full set of 7 fragments is on hand (tab badge counts digs)
Radar - Quick Execute to empty, Claim All, do special pins individually, claim the free 75 stamina when offered
Survivor intake - take in the gate line, then Quick Dispatch in building panels
Trucks - settle returned trucks via Truck Details, claim trade Reward Recovery, dispatch to fill (duel UR days Mega + UR only, other days SR/SSR/UR), plunder to the cap by the UR shard rule
Alliance train - if a train is in preparation board carriage 2 with a 3-contract ticket; claim train arrival mail
Troop training - requeue any finished barracks at its highest tier
Alliance tech donations - gold-coin donations to the recommended tech (as in the daily round)
Event claims - claim earned milestones only (Battle Pass daily login, Halloween check-in while it runs, Arms Race earned chests); never grind, never buy
Arms Race - read the phase; complete free or already-earned tasks only; claim earned chests
Ghost Ops - event day only (Thursdays, server windows); help allies 3x, claim manually
Alliance Star Ceremony - when the trophy icon shows; send at least 3 hearts, claim the rewards
